name: log_catch
description: Fishers log trip catches in community ledger

catch_kg.description: Amount of catch logged in kilograms

prompt.template:
You are {agent_id}. You are required to log your catch from your fishing trip.

You just returned from the lake with {catch_kg}kg of fish. Your catch log must be submitted to the community ledger.

This logging will be verified by the steward, who will check this against the community's records. 

What do you do? You must log your catch.
